units.source_text: 无人居住的金阁，除了究竟顶和潮音洞的两层屋顶加上漱清殿的小屋顶这三层屋顶呈现了轮廓分明的白色部分之外，

en.t: The uninhabited Golden Pavilion, apart from the sharply outlined white portions formed by the three roofs: the two tiers over Kukkyoucho and Chouondou, together with the small roof of Souseiden,

units.source_text: 昏暗而复杂的木质结构在雪中显出了黝黝的黑色。

en.t: showed its dim and intricate wooden structure as a deep, dark black amid the snow.

units.source_text: 这古色古香的黑木色泽的艳丽，也使我不由得想窥视一下金闻里是不是有人居住，

en.t: The vivid beauty of that antique black wooden sheen also made me unable to resist wanting to peer inside the Golden Pavilion to see whether anyone lived there,

units.source_text: 就像我们观赏南画的山中楼阁之类的景物时，也会抽冷子把脸凑近画面窥视一下里面是不是有人居住一样。

en.t: just as, when looking at a southern-style painting of a pavilion in the mountains, we may suddenly bring our faces close to the picture and peer in to see whether anyone lives inside.

units.source_text: 然而即使凑近过去，我的脸也只能碰在画着白雪的冰冷的经绢上，不可能有比这更深的接近。

en.t: Yet even if I drew close, my face could only touch the cold silk on which the white snow was painted; any deeper approach than that was impossible.
